actual_128_logic: Planned two-stage fold-local implementation. RN mining is fit-only; no validation/test row may enter RN mining. Validation selects only predeclared choices.
authority_note: The 2024 paper fixes 15% spies and RF as the prior classifier, and reports BRF; no official code was located. The prose says only that the threshold is based on spy probabilities, not a unique threshold functional.
benchmark_adaptations: frozen validation selection instead of regional susceptibility zoning
critical_ambiguity: RN threshold and full RF/BRF parameterization are not uniquely specified; imbalanced-learn is absent from the frozen environment.
fit_semantics: P=inventory-supported positive; U=matched non-inventory controls, not verified negatives
implementation_choices: RN cap/imbalance ratio if RN candidates exceed available U
original_paper_logic: Randomly move 15% of P to U as spies; train a first RF on remaining P versus U+spies; derive an RN threshold from spy probabilities; restore all P; train the final imbalance-aware BRF on P and RN.
seed_policy: fixed per outer fold/config before execution; never selected by test metrics
